quest.title: Adventurer Exam: The Art of Adventure
quest.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's how it is...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Brother, do you know what these plants can do aside from being edible?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to know that?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I just know where you can find them and whether you can eat them or not.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Huh... Then I guess I should go check them out myself. Don't worry, I'm just going to gather some plants. I won't go anywhere near those monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: ...Oh, just be careful, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I know, I know. Well, I'll be a bit late back today, then.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Hey there, Traveler! Great timing — I was just planning to go out to observe some plants.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Cyrus told me that adventurers will often camp out in the wilds, where foraging is a very important skill.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: As such, I'm planning to go investigate some wild plants, check out their features and characteristics, and then commit them to memory slowly.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: That way, I'll at least know what I can and cannot eat out there in the future.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: However, I don't think that pure writing is going to be very intuitive.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Traveler, I've heard that you have a gadget known as the Kamera. Is that true?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: If so, could you help me snap some photos of a few plant species in their natural habitats?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Nice! In that case, could you get me photos of Calla Lilies, Small Lamp Grass, and Cecilias?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: After that, please help me gather these three plant species. I'd like to keep them as samples.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Images of these plants in their natural habitats, live specimens, and detailed descriptions...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: The botany section of my handbook looks to be in pretty good shape!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Alright then, Traveler, I'm counting on you.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: The spring in Springvale plays host to large numbers of Calla Lilies, while Small Lamp Grass is common in Wolvendom.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: As for Cecilias... it's got to be Starsnatch Cliff.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: I'll continue my own plant observations elsewhere in the meantime.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Once you've got the pictures, let's meet up in the city.

talks.objective: Take a photo recording the Calla Lily's habitat
Take a photo recording the Small Lamp Grass' habitat

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Well, how does it look? Pretty good, huh? I hope you'll enjoy it!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: As for me, I'll go write those notes up. Hmm, as for these plants...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'll go ask Jack if he knows how to preserve plant specimens.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: As for the Cecilias, I guess they'd look better in a vase somewhere instead of serving as specimens...

talks.objective: Take a photo recording the Cecilia's habitat

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: You're back, Traveler! How have things gone? Did you manage to get those pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pictures and samples, got them all right here.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow! That was super fast! I guess that's a seasoned adventurer for you, huh? You're amazing...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Traveler! Actually, how about this? Let me make you a meal to show my thanks. I guarantee it'll be good!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Well, how does it look? Pretty good, huh? I hope you'll enjoy it!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: As for me, I'll go write those notes up. Hmm, as for these plants...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'll go ask Jack if he knows how to preserve plant specimens.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: As for the Cecilias, I guess they'd look better in a vase somewhere instead of serving as specimens...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: *sigh* She's not really trying to become an adventurer, is she?
